method: Exact enumeration under scriptwob-observed-queue-length-v2, conditioned on solvability
formula: H(B | fixed script, observed queue lengths/cursors, solvable reference state) = -sum_b p(b) log2 p(b)
conditioning_scope: Queue sizes, cursors and existing record metadata fixed; remaining relevant item category/status vary. Counter prior remains 0..3; toggles and status widgets vary.
choice_cost_definition: sum_t log2(number of enabled semantic buttons before correct action t), including Done; evaluated on the original oracle trace; reported separately from entropy

binning.empty_bins: Retained in table with null rates; omitted from plot

outcome_definition: One original saved SeeClick attempt per task; no new policy rollouts

intervals.caveat: Approximate binomial intervals; related templates need not be independent

pooled_binning.method: Pool adjacent positive entropy values; merge undersized tail backward
